title: The One Support Line Every Bear Is Stuck Behind
speaker: Tim Knight (with tastylive hosts)

macro_themes.view: Market in stasis after CPI; heavy Nasdaq-concentrated earnings over the next week and a half should set direction.
Not getting aggressively positioned until the election (two weeks away) clears; a big Dem night could hurt Tesla/SpaceX.
Intraday crude collapse fuelled the turnaround in indices and airlines.

calls.reason: Horizontal support from the July/August breakout keeps holding against selling; until it breaks, bears are stuck, though co-host says it could go either way.
calls.quote: that support is holding like crazy and until it breaks it's going to be a little frustrating for the one or two bears

calls.reason: Grinding around for four days below resistance (broken trendline plus former lifetime high); market in stasis awaiting earnings for direction.
calls.quote: this zone here which is a combination of this broken trend line as well as this horizontal... That's kind of the the area of resistance.

calls.reason: Working lower for months, approaching resistance, richly valued and rarely rallies on earnings; expects a drop after earnings tomorrow (no position).
calls.quote: I'm inclined to believe Tesla will fall tomorrow um and that's having no position in it

calls.reason: Stock keeps gravitating to ~150 ahead of earnings this evening; long-term bull, short-term no view.
calls.quote: I'm a long-term bull on this, but short-term hands thrown firmly up in the air.

calls.reason: Space ETF (Rocket Lab, Planet Labs etc.) chart looks very bearish.
calls.quote: UFO which is the ETF that uh wraps up all this rocket and space stuff is looking crazy bearish.

calls.condition: Uptrend holds unless the higher-low trendline breaks.
calls.reason: Down ~2.5% intraday after multi-week high, but series of higher lows keeps the uptrend intact until broken.
calls.quote: that uptrend is still in place, and that would be the thing they would need to break

notes: Date inferred from 'two weeks from today is election day' (Nov 3, 2026) = Tue Oct 20; listing said Oct 21. ES 7779 and NQ 29837 quoted by anchor at end (NQ not recorded as a call—no view). SpaceX ticker assumed SPCX.
